description: The plot illustrates how MRR@10 varies with the number of queries used during inference for several DPR variants, shown as multiple colored lines with markers and corresponding dashed trend lines. The x-axis is labeled “# of queries used during inference (S)” on a linear scale, with visible tick labels at 4, 6, and 8 (units not specified) and the plotted range extending from roughly 3 to 9. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 33.5 to 36.5 with tick labels at 33.5, 34.0, 34.5, 35.0, 35.5, and 36.0 (tick interval 0.5). A black solid line (no visible markers) labeled “DPR w/o query” appears as a flat horizontal baseline around 34.4 across the x-range. A yellow solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ gold”) starts near 33.5 around S≈4 and increases steadily, reaching about 35.8 by S≈9; a yellow dashed line of the same color runs above it with a similar upward slope. A green solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ top-1”) begins around 34.7 near S≈3, rises sharply to about 35.0 at S≈4, continues upward to roughly 36.0 at S≈6, and reaches about 36.5 by S≈9; a green dashed line accompanies it with a gentler upward slope. A purple solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ bottom-1”) increases gradually from about 34.9 at S≈3 to about 35.6 at S≈9, with a purple dashed line tracking a similar gradual rise. A blue solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ random”) rises from about 34.9 at S≈3 to about 35.9 at S≈9, with a blue dashed line closely following the same upward trend. A red solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ curriculum”) increases from about 35.2 at S≈3 to about 36.3 at S≈9, and a red dashed line runs slightly below the solid red series while also increasing across the x-axis.
